content: NewPipeExtractor breaks whenever YouTube changes player internals; recurring symptoms: network errors, 403, 'watch on latest version of YouTube' (NewPipe issue 12930, NPE issue 1185). Actively maintained, releases track breakage (v0.25.1 had BREAKING date-parsing refactor; v0.26.x shipped YouTube BotGuard/duration fixes into 2026). Distributed via JitPack com.github.TeamNewPipe:NewPipeExtractor — pin exact tag, never HEAD/-SNAPSHOT.
